about_the_game:
Bayaya Creator Pack is a comprehensive toolkit for creative players, artists, and modders who want to expand or reshape the world of Bayaya.

Included tools:

  • Model Editor – Create or modify 3D models in the game’s signature wooden toy style

  • World Editor – Design your own villages, forests, and landscapes using procedural generation tools

  • Animation Editor – Create or edit character animations for fully custom behavior

  • In-Game Debug Tools – Use developer-grade features like a scripting console and interactive settings window for real-time tweaking and testing

These are the same tools used by the development team and allow deep customization of both visuals and gameplay. Build your own stories, characters, and settings—and bring your unique vision to life within the Bayaya universe.
